# Java signing compatibility fixture

`java-signed-v1.jar` is generated by the parent Java repository's test-only
`io.kyle.javaguard.test.JavaSignedFixtureGenerator`. It contains a deterministic,
executable JAR with fixed ZIP timestamps, stored entries, and the nonempty original
ZIP comment `java-guard deterministic interop fixture`. The generator signs it by
calling the production `ZipSignUtils.sign` implementation.

The signing seed is RFC 8032 section 7.1 test vector 1. It is public test material
and must never be used for production signing. Its Ed25519 public key is
`d75a980182b10ab7d54bfed3c964073a0ee172f3daa62325af021a68f707511a`.

From the parent `java-guard` repository root, regenerate with Maven's compiled test
classpath (replace `mvn` with the local Maven executable if needed):

```sh
mvn test-compile dependency:build-classpath -Dmdep.outputFile=target/test-classpath.txt
java -cp "target/test-classes;target/classes;$(cat target/test-classpath.txt)" \
  io.kyle.javaguard.test.JavaSignedFixtureGenerator \
  jg-launcher/tests/fixtures/java-signed-v1.jar
```

On Unix, use `:` instead of `;` between the first three classpath components.
Expected SHA-256:

```text
f484337538b8615939654b61646d7038fd52a4d4282f8a866e9f5e362e547dff
```
